title: 第7章 我们结婚为了孩子第8章 我也确实小心眼
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
气氛沉闷压抑。
宋佳硬着头皮解释道：“柳总，叶子认出了叶凡，在外面哭着喊着不让他走，同事们都在看，我只能让他们先进来。”
“出去。”
“啊？”
宋佳小心翼翼道：“可柳总，同事们肯定还在关注这里，叶凡出去的话……”
“你出去。”
“……”宋佳。
等到秘书离开。
柳盈盈温柔道：“叶子，过来妈妈这里，今天在幼儿园乖不乖，麻麻晚上给你做好吃的好不好呀。”
“麻麻，他是爸爸。”
小叶子大眼睛虽然挂着泪珠，却明亮亮的。
柳盈盈没说话，冷冷扫了一眼叶凡。
叶凡心领神会，轻轻捏了捏小丫头的脸，有些不舍道：“小叶子，乖，去你麻麻那里。”
“爸爸你是不是走？你不要走，不要丢下我跟麻麻。叶子会乖乖听话的，再也不挑食了，麻麻说过，等叶子长大你就会回来，麻麻从不骗人的。”
叶子紧紧抱着叶凡脖子不肯撒手，声音带着哭腔，一串串泪珠哗啦啦掉。
柳盈盈有些头疼。
她从未设想过的场景出现了。
过去几年，她并没有对女儿隐瞒叶凡的存在，反倒向女儿讲述叶凡是多么的优秀，讲述他们二人间的小甜蜜。
而死亡对于孩子是难以理解的事，也过于残忍，所以每当小叶子问爸爸在哪里时，柳盈盈就会用善意的谎言，来填充女儿人生中关于父亲的缺失部分。
“你爸爸呢，有很重要的工作要忙，等你长大了他就会回来，到时候我们一家三口就能永远生活在一起啦。”

……
曾经说过的话历历在耳。
柳盈盈本以为等到女儿长大了，哪怕知道父亲英年早逝也会明白她这个当妈的良苦用心。
可万万没想到。
叶凡没死，他回来了……
所以柳盈盈此刻不知怎么向女儿解释，一向立志做好妈妈的她，第一次有了慌乱。
“叶子，你麻麻没骗你，爸爸不会走的。”
叶凡抱着小叶子，越看越喜欢，但也有些不知所措，毕竟他是第一次当爹，完全没有经验。
“那爸爸会跟叶子一块住吗……”
叶子一边抽噎，一边可怜巴巴的扬起小脸看着叶凡。
“这恐怕……”
content_en:
The atmosphere was dull and depressing.
Song Jia bit the bullet and explained: "Mr. Liu, Ye Zi recognized Ye Fan and was crying and shouting outside not to let him go. My colleagues were all watching, so I had no choice but to let them in first."
"Get out."
"Huh?"
Song Jia said cautiously: "But Mr. Liu, my colleagues must still be paying attention to this place. If Ye Fan goes out..."
"You get out."
"..." Song Jia.
Wait until the secretary leaves.
Liu Yingying said softly: "Yi Zi, come over to mom. Are you going to be good in the kindergarten today? Mom will prepare something delicious for you tonight, okay?"
"Mom, he is daddy."
Although there were tears in Little Ye Zi's big eyes, they were bright.
Liu Yingying said nothing and glanced at Ye Fan coldly.
Ye Fan understood, gently pinched the little girl's face, and said with some reluctance: "Little Yezi, be good, go to your mom's place."
"Dad, are you leaving? Don't leave, don't leave me and Mom. Ye Zi will be obedient and won't be picky about food anymore. Mom said that you will come back when Ye Zi grows up. Mom never lies."
Ye Zi hugged Ye Fan's neck tightly and refused to let go, his voice was crying, and strings of tears fell.
Liu Yingying had a headache.
Scenarios emerged that she had never imagined.
In the past few years, she did not hide Ye Fan's existence from her daughter. Instead, she told her daughter how outstanding Ye Fan was and the little sweetness between the two of them.
Death is something that is difficult for children to understand and is too cruel, so whenever Little Leaf asks where her father is, Liu Yingying will use white lies to fill in the missing parts of her daughter's life about her father.
"Where's your dad? He has a very important job to be busy with. He will come back when you grow up, and then our family of three will be able to live together forever."
…
The words I once said are still fresh in my ears.
Liu Yingying thought that when her daughter grew up, even if she knew that her father died young, she would understand her good intentions as a mother.
But I never expected it.
Ye Fan is not dead, he is back...
So Liu Yingying didn't know how to explain to her daughter at this moment. She, who had always been determined to be a good mother, was panicked for the first time.
"Yi Zi, Mommy didn't lie to you. Dad won't leave."
Ye Fan held Xiao Zizi and liked it more and more, but he was also a little overwhelmed. After all, he was a father for the first time and had no experience at all.
"Then will Dad live with Ye Zi..."
While Ye Zi was sobbing, he raised his little face pitifully and looked at Mark.
"I'm afraid..."
